title.hg: Pregnancy Actually Kaise Shuru Hoti Hai

subtitle.en: Fertilisation, implantation and nine months in brief
subtitle.hg: Fertilisation, implantation aur nau mahinon ki short story

hook.en: No stork and no magic. One egg, one sperm and a very precise chain of events.
hook.hg: Na koi pari, na koi jaadu. Ek egg, ek sperm aur events ki ek bahut precise chain.

objectives.en: Describe fertilisation and implantation in the correct order.
objectives.hg: Fertilisation aur implantation ko sahi order mein samjha sako.

objectives.en: Explain what the placenta and umbilical cord do.
objectives.hg: Bata sako ki placenta aur umbilical cord kya kaam karte hain.

objectives.en: Outline the three trimesters of pregnancy.
objectives.hg: Pregnancy ke teen trimesters ka outline bata sako.

h.en: Egg meets sperm

body.en: About once in each menstrual cycle, an ovary releases an egg. This is ovulation. The egg moves into the fallopian tube and survives for roughly a day. If semen enters the vagina during sexual intercourse, sperm swim through the cervix and uterus into the tubes, where they can stay alive for up to about five days. If one sperm enters the egg, their genetic material joins. That is fertilisation, and the single new cell is called a zygote. It carries half its instructions from each biological parent, including the X or Y chromosome from the sperm, which usually determines the baby's sex.
body.hg: Har menstrual cycle mein lagbhag ek baar ovary ek egg release karti hai. Isse ovulation kehte hain. Egg fallopian tube mein pahunchta hai aur lagbhag ek din zinda rehta hai. Agar sexual intercourse ke dauraan semen vagina mein jaaye, toh sperm cervix aur uterus se tairte hue tubes tak pahunchte hain, jahan woh lagbhag paanch din tak zinda reh sakte hain. Agar ek sperm egg ke andar chala jaaye, toh dono ka genetic material mil jaata hai. Yahi fertilisation hai, aur is ek nayi cell ko zygote kehte hain. Isme aadhe instructions ek biological parent se aur aadhe doosre se aate hain, jisme sperm ka X ya Y chromosome bhi shaamil hai, jo aam taur par baby ka sex decide karta hai.

h.en: Implantation and the placenta

body.en: The fertilised egg divides again and again as it travels down the tube. After about a week it reaches the uterus and burrows into the soft lining; this is implantation, and from this point the body starts producing the pregnancy hormone hCG. The lining is not shed, so periods stop. A new organ, the placenta, forms and attaches to the wall of the uterus. Through the umbilical cord it passes oxygen and nutrients from the pregnant person's blood to the baby and carries waste away. The baby floats in amniotic fluid, which cushions it. It does not breathe air or eat through the mouth before birth.
body.hg: Fertilised egg tube se neeche aate hue baar-baar divide hota rehta hai. Lagbhag ek hafte baad woh uterus mein pahunchkar uski soft lining mein dhans jaata hai; isse implantation kehte hain, aur yahin se body pregnancy hormone hCG banana shuru karti hai. Ab lining shed nahi hoti, isliye periods ruk jaate hain. Ek naya organ, placenta, banta hai aur uterus ki wall se jud jaata hai. Umbilical cord ke through woh pregnant person ke blood se oxygen aur nutrients baby tak pahunchata hai aur waste bahar le jaata hai. Baby amniotic fluid mein float karta hai, jo usse jhatkon se bachata hai. Birth se pehle woh na hawa mein saans leta hai, na munh se khata hai.

h.en: Nine months, three trimesters

body.en: Pregnancy lasts about 40 weeks, counted from the first day of the last period, and is divided into three trimesters. In the first, up to about week 12, the brain, heart, spine and limbs form; the developing baby is called an embryo and later a fetus. In the second, up to about week 27, it grows quickly and the pregnant person usually begins to feel movement. In the third, it gains weight and the lungs mature. Most babies are born between 37 and 42 weeks. Birth happens through the vagina or by a surgical operation called a caesarean section.
body.hg: Pregnancy lagbhag 40 hafte chalti hai, jinhe last period ke pehle din se gina jaata hai, aur isse teen trimesters mein baanta jaata hai. Pehle trimester mein, lagbhag week 12 tak, brain, heart, spine aur haath-pair bante hain; develop ho rahe baby ko pehle embryo aur baad mein fetus kaha jaata hai. Doosre trimester mein, lagbhag week 27 tak, woh tezi se badhta hai aur pregnant person ko aam taur par uski movement feel hone lagti hai. Teesre trimester mein uska weight badhta hai aur lungs mature hote hain. Zyadatar babies 37 se 42 hafte ke beech paida hote hain. Birth vagina ke raaste hota hai ya caesarean section naam ke operation se.

h.en: What this means at your age
h.hg: Tumhari age mein iska kya matlab hai

body.en: Pregnancy can happen whenever sperm reaches an egg, even the first time someone has intercourse. It cannot happen from kissing, hugging, toilet seats or swimming pools. Bodies can get pregnant from puberty, long before people are ready. Teenage pregnancy is riskier for mother and baby and often interrupts school. In India any sexual act with a person under 18 is an offence under POCSO, even if they agreed. If you ever worry about pregnancy, tell a trusted adult or a doctor quickly, or call Child Helpline 1098. A doctor cannot promise full secrecy to someone under 18, but early help is far safer than hiding it.
body.hg: Jab bhi sperm egg tak pahunchta hai, pregnancy ho sakti hai, pehli baar intercourse karne par bhi. Kiss karne, hug karne, toilet seat ya swimming pool se pregnancy nahi hoti. Puberty se hi body pregnant hone layak ho jaati hai, jabki insaan bahut baad mein ready hota hai. Teenage pregnancy mother aur baby dono ke liye zyada risky hoti hai aur aksar padhai rok deti hai. India mein POCSO Act ke under 18 se kam umar ke person ke saath koi bhi sexual act offence hai, chahe usne haan hi kyun na boli ho. Agar kabhi pregnancy ki tension ho, toh jaldi kisi trusted adult ya doctor ko batao, ya Child Helpline 1098 par call karo. Doctor 18 se kam umar walon se full secrecy ka promise nahi kar sakte, lekin jaldi help lena chhupane se kahin zyada safe hai.

claim.en: A baby grows in the mother's stomach.
claim.hg: Baby maa ke stomach mein grow karta hai.

fact.en: A baby grows in the uterus, a muscular organ in the lower abdomen that is separate from the stomach and the digestive system. Food never touches the baby; nutrients arrive through the placenta and umbilical cord.
fact.hg: Baby uterus mein grow karta hai, jo lower abdomen mein muscles se bana ek organ hai aur stomach aur digestive system se bilkul alag hai. Khana baby ko kabhi touch bhi nahi karta; nutrients placenta aur umbilical cord ke through pahunchte hain.

takeaways.en: Fertilisation is one sperm joining one egg, usually in the fallopian tube.
takeaways.hg: Fertilisation ka matlab hai ek sperm ka ek egg se milna, jo aam taur par fallopian tube mein hota hai.

takeaways.en: The placenta and umbilical cord supply oxygen and nutrients throughout pregnancy.
takeaways.hg: Poori pregnancy mein placenta aur umbilical cord oxygen aur nutrients supply karte hain.

takeaways.en: Pregnancy is possible from the first intercourse, and worries should go to a trusted adult or doctor early.
takeaways.hg: Pehle intercourse se bhi pregnancy possible hai, aur tension ho toh jaldi kisi trusted adult ya doctor ke paas jaana chahiye.

activity.en: Draw a simple timeline from ovulation to birth with five labels: ovulation, fertilisation, implantation, placenta forms, birth. Check it against this lesson.
activity.hg: Ovulation se birth tak ki ek simple timeline banao aur us par paanch labels lagao: ovulation, fertilisation, implantation, placenta banna, birth. Phir isse is lesson se match karke dekho.

options.en: Releases an egg every month
options.hg: Har mahine ek egg release karta hai

options.en: Passes oxygen and nutrients to the baby and removes waste
options.hg: Baby tak oxygen aur nutrients pahunchata hai aur waste hatata hai

options.en: Digests the mother's food for the baby
options.hg: Baby ke liye maa ka khana digest karta hai

options.en: Produces sperm
options.hg: Sperm banata hai

explain.en: The placenta is a temporary organ that links the baby to the pregnant person's blood supply through the umbilical cord.
explain.hg: Placenta ek temporary organ hai jo umbilical cord ke through baby ko pregnant person ki blood supply se jodta hai.

q.en: Pregnancy can happen the very first time a person has sexual intercourse.
q.hg: Pehli baar sexual intercourse karne par bhi pregnancy ho sakti hai.

options.en: True
options.hg: Sahi

options.en: False
options.hg: Galat

explain.en: If an egg is present and sperm reaches it, fertilisation can occur. The body does not count how many times someone has had sex.
explain.hg: Agar egg present hai aur sperm us tak pahunch jaaye, toh fertilisation ho sakta hai. Body yeh count nahi karti ki kisi ne kitni baar sex kiya hai.

title.en: Am I Pregnant? Signs, Tests and Their Limits
title.hg: Kya Main Pregnant Hoon? Signs, Tests aur Unki Limits

subtitle.en: What symptoms and home tests can and cannot tell you
subtitle.hg: Symptoms aur home tests kya bata sakte hain aur kya nahi

hook.en: A late period is not proof. A negative test on day one is not proof either. Here is how to actually know, and what to do next.
hook.hg: Period late hona proof nahi hai. Pehle hi din aaya negative test bhi proof nahi hai. Yeh raha actually pata karne ka tareeka, aur uske baad kya karna hai.

objectives.en: List common early signs of pregnancy and their other causes.
objectives.hg: Pregnancy ke common early signs aur unki doosri wajahein bata sako.

objectives.en: Explain how and when to use a home pregnancy test.
objectives.hg: Samjha sako ki home pregnancy test kaise aur kab karna hai.

objectives.en: State what a home test cannot show and what the next steps are.
objectives.hg: Bata sako ki home test kya nahi dikha sakta aur next steps kya hain.

h.en: Early signs, and why none of them is proof
h.hg: Early signs, aur inme se koi bhi proof kyun nahi hai

body.en: The most common early sign is a missed period. Others include nausea or vomiting at any time of day, sore or swollen breasts, unusual tiredness, passing urine more often, and light spotting around the time the period was due. Some people notice nothing for weeks. Every one of these signs also has other causes: stress, illness, weight change, heavy exercise, exam pressure or conditions like PCOS can delay periods, and premenstrual symptoms mimic early pregnancy. Symptoms are a reason to test, never a result. Light bleeding does not rule pregnancy out either.
body.hg: Sabse common early sign hai period miss hona. Doosre signs hain: din ke kisi bhi time nausea ya vomiting, breasts mein dard ya swelling, bewajah ki thakaan, baar-baar urine aana, aur period ki date ke aaspaas halki spotting. Kuch logon ko hafton tak kuch feel nahi hota. Inme se har sign ki doosri wajahein bhi hoti hain: stress, bimari, weight change, bahut zyada exercise, exam pressure ya PCOS jaisi conditions period late kar sakti hain, aur PMS ke symptoms early pregnancy jaise hi lagte hain. Symptoms test karne ki wajah hain, result kabhi nahi. Halki bleeding hone se bhi pregnancy rule out nahi hoti.

h.en: How home tests work and when to take one
h.hg: Home tests kaise kaam karte hain aur kab karna chahiye

body.en: A home pregnancy test is a strip or stick sold at chemists without a prescription. It detects hCG, a hormone that appears in urine only after a fertilised egg has implanted. Because hCG rises over days, the test is most reliable from the first day of a missed period; with irregular cycles, about three weeks after the unprotected sex is a common guide. Follow the leaflet, check the expiry date and read the result within the stated time. A positive result is very likely correct. A negative result taken too early can be wrong, so repeat it after a few days if the period still has not come.
body.hg: Home pregnancy test ek strip ya stick hoti hai jo chemist ke yahan bina prescription ke milti hai. Yeh hCG detect karti hai, ek aisa hormone jo urine mein tabhi aata hai jab fertilised egg implant ho chuka ho. hCG din-ba-din badhta hai, isliye test missed period ke pehle din se sabse reliable hota hai; agar cycles irregular hon, toh unprotected sex ke lagbhag teen hafte baad test karna ek common guide hai. Leaflet ke instructions follow karo, expiry date check karo aur result bataye gaye time ke andar hi padho. Positive result almost hamesha sahi hota hai. Bahut jaldi kiya gaya negative test galat ho sakta hai, isliye agar period phir bhi na aaye toh kuch din baad dobara test karo.

h.en: What a home test cannot tell you
h.hg: Home test kya nahi bata sakta

body.en: A home test answers one question: is hCG present? It cannot say how many weeks the pregnancy is, whether it is growing inside the uterus or in the wrong place, or whether it is developing normally. It also cannot tell when or with whom conception happened. That is why a positive test should be followed by a visit to a doctor, who can confirm with a urine or blood test and, when needed, an ultrasound scan. A positive test together with one-sided lower abdominal pain, vaginal bleeding, shoulder-tip pain or fainting may mean an ectopic pregnancy and needs hospital care immediately.
body.hg: Home test bas ek sawaal ka jawab deta hai: kya hCG present hai? Yeh nahi bata sakta ki pregnancy kitne hafte ki hai, woh uterus ke andar grow ho rahi hai ya galat jagah par, aur uska development normal hai ya nahi. Yeh yeh bhi nahi bata sakta ki conception kab aur kiske saath hua. Isiliye positive test ke baad doctor ke paas jaana chahiye, jo urine ya blood test se, aur zaroorat padne par ultrasound se confirm kar sakte hain. Agar positive test ke saath lower abdomen mein ek taraf dard, vaginal bleeding, shoulder-tip pain ya behoshi ho, toh yeh ectopic pregnancy ho sakti hai aur turant hospital jaana zaroori hai.

h.en: If the test is positive and you are under 18
h.hg: Agar test positive hai aur tum 18 se kam ho

body.en: Three paths are lawful: continuing the pregnancy to parent, placing the baby for adoption, or abortion, legal under the MTP Act when a qualified doctor does it at an approved facility. Under 18, an abortion needs a guardian's written consent. Any sexual act with a minor is a POCSO offence, so doctors must report it to the police and cannot promise total secrecy; the law sees you as someone to protect. If anyone forced or pressured you, it is not your fault. Tell a trusted adult and see a doctor early, or call Child Helpline 1098. Never take pills bought on your own. Laws change; this is not legal advice.
body.hg: Legally teen raaste hain: pregnancy continue karna aur parenting, pregnancy continue karna aur baby ko adoption ke liye dena, ya abortion, jo MTP Act ke under legal hai, bas qualified doctor approved facility par kare. 18 se kam umar mein abortion ke liye guardian ki written consent zaroori hai. POCSO ke under minor ke saath koi bhi sexual act offence hai, isliye doctors ko iski report police ko karni hoti hai aur woh total secrecy ka promise nahi kar sakte; law tumhe aisa person maanta hai jisse protect karna hai. Agar kisi ne zabardasti ki ya pressure daala, toh isme tumhari galti nahi hai. Kisi trusted adult ko batao aur jaldi doctor se milo, ya Child Helpline 1098 par call karo. Khud se khareedi pills kabhi mat lo. Laws badalte hain; yeh legal advice nahi hai.

claim.en: If I had some bleeding, I cannot be pregnant.
claim.hg: Agar thodi bleeding hui hai, toh main pregnant nahi ho sakti.

fact.en: Light bleeding or spotting can occur in early pregnancy, and some people mistake it for a period. If the bleeding was lighter, shorter or different from usual and pregnancy is possible, take a test.
fact.hg: Early pregnancy mein halki bleeding ya spotting ho sakti hai, aur kuch log isse period samajh lete hain. Agar bleeding usual se halki, chhoti ya alag thi aur pregnancy possible hai, toh test karo.

takeaways.en: Symptoms suggest; only a test confirms, and it is most reliable from the first day of a missed period.
takeaways.hg: Symptoms sirf hint dete hain; confirm test se hi hota hai, aur woh missed period ke pehle din se sabse reliable hai.

takeaways.en: A home test cannot show how far along the pregnancy is or whether it is in the uterus.
takeaways.hg: Home test yeh nahi dikha sakta ki pregnancy kitne hafte ki hai ya woh uterus mein hai ya nahi.

takeaways.en: After a positive test, see a doctor early with a trusted adult, and never self-medicate.
takeaways.hg: Positive test ke baad kisi trusted adult ke saath jaldi doctor se milo, aur self-medication kabhi mat karo.

activity.en: Find out where the nearest government health centre or Adolescent Friendly Health Clinic is and note its timings. Knowing where to go is useful for you or a friend, whether or not you ever need it.
activity.hg: Pata karo ki sabse paas ka government health centre ya Adolescent Friendly Health Clinic kahan hai aur uski timings note kar lo. Kahan jaana hai, yeh jaanna tumhare ya kisi friend ke kaam aa sakta hai, chahe kabhi zaroorat pade ya nahi.

q.en: From when is a home pregnancy test most reliable?
q.hg: Home pregnancy test kab se sabse reliable hota hai?

options.en: The morning after sex
options.hg: Sex ke agli subah se

options.en: From the first day of a missed period
options.hg: Missed period ke pehle din se

options.en: Only after three missed periods
options.hg: Teen periods miss hone ke baad hi

options.en: Any time; timing makes no difference
options.hg: Kisi bhi time; timing se koi fark nahi padta

explain.en: The hormone hCG needs time to build up after implantation, so testing before a missed period often gives a false negative.
explain.hg: Implantation ke baad hCG hormone ko build up hone mein time lagta hai, isliye missed period se pehle kiya gaya test aksar false negative deta hai.

q.en: Which of these can a home pregnancy test tell you?
q.hg: Inme se kaun-si baat home pregnancy test bata sakta hai?

options.en: How many weeks pregnant you are
options.hg: Pregnancy kitne hafte ki hai

options.en: Whether the pregnancy is inside the uterus
options.hg: Pregnancy uterus ke andar hai ya nahi

options.en: Whether the pregnancy hormone is present in urine
options.hg: Urine mein pregnancy hormone present hai ya nahi

explain.en: The test only detects the hormone. Dating the pregnancy and checking its location need a doctor and usually an ultrasound.
explain.hg: Test sirf hormone detect karta hai. Pregnancy kitne time ki hai aur kahan hai, yeh jaanne ke liye doctor aur usually ultrasound ki zaroorat hoti hai.

warning.en: A positive test with one-sided lower abdominal pain, vaginal bleeding, shoulder-tip pain or fainting needs emergency hospital care. Call 112 if needed.
warning.hg: Positive test ke saath lower abdomen mein ek taraf dard, vaginal bleeding, shoulder-tip pain ya behoshi ho, toh turant hospital emergency jaana zaroori hai. Zaroorat ho toh 112 par call karo.

title.en: Pregnancy Care and When Things Go Wrong
title.hg: Pregnancy Care aur Jab Kuch Galat Ho Jaaye

subtitle.en: Prenatal check-ups, miscarriage and ectopic warning signs
subtitle.hg: Prenatal check-ups, miscarriage aur ectopic ke warning signs

hook.en: Most pregnancies go well with regular check-ups. Some end early, and it is almost never anyone's fault. A few are emergencies. Knowing which is which saves lives.
hook.hg: Regular check-ups ke saath zyadatar pregnancies theek chalti hain. Kuch jaldi khatam ho jaati hain, aur isme almost kabhi kisi ki galti nahi hoti. Kuch emergency hoti hain. Fark pehchanna jaan bachata hai.

objectives.en: Describe what prenatal check-ups include and why they matter.
objectives.hg: Bata sako ki prenatal check-ups mein kya hota hai aur woh kyun zaroori hain.

objectives.en: Explain what causes most miscarriages and why blame is wrong.
objectives.hg: Samjha sako ki zyadatar miscarriages kis wajah se hote hain aur blame karna kyun galat hai.

objectives.en: Recognise the warning signs of ectopic pregnancy that need emergency care.
objectives.hg: Ectopic pregnancy ke woh warning signs pehchaan sako jinme emergency care chahiye.

h.en: What prenatal care does

body.en: Prenatal, or antenatal, care means regular check-ups during pregnancy, ideally starting in the first three months. At government health centres in India, registration and check-ups are provided free. A health worker checks blood pressure, weight, the baby's growth and heartbeat, and tests blood and urine for anaemia, blood group, diabetes and infections such as HIV and syphilis. Iron and folic acid supplements and tetanus vaccination are given as advised, and ultrasound scans check development. The visits also catch danger signs early: severe headache, blurred vision, swelling of the face and hands, bleeding, fever, or the baby moving less. Alcohol, tobacco and any medicine not approved by the doctor should be avoided.
body.hg: Prenatal, yaani antenatal, care ka matlab hai pregnancy ke dauraan regular check-ups, jo better hai ki pehle teen mahinon mein hi shuru ho jaayein. India ke government health centres par registration aur check-ups free hote hain. Health worker blood pressure, weight, baby ki growth aur heartbeat check karte hain, aur blood aur urine tests se anaemia, blood group, diabetes aur HIV aur syphilis jaise infections ka pata lagate hain. Advice ke hisaab se iron aur folic acid supplements aur tetanus ka teeka diya jaata hai, aur ultrasound se development dekha jaata hai. In visits mein danger signs bhi jaldi pakad mein aate hain: tez sirdard, dhundhla dikhna, chehre aur haathon mein swelling, bleeding, bukhaar, ya baby ki movement kam hona. Alcohol, tobacco aur aisi har medicine se bachna chahiye jisse doctor ne approve na kiya ho.

h.en: Miscarriage: common, and not anyone's fault
h.hg: Miscarriage: common hai, aur kisi ki galti nahi

body.en: A miscarriage is the loss of a pregnancy on its own in the early or middle months, most often in the first twelve weeks. It is common. The usual cause is a chromosome problem in the embryo that happened by chance at fertilisation, which nobody could have prevented. Ordinary life does not cause it: not lifting something, climbing stairs, travelling, working, exercise, an argument, stress, spicy food or sex. Signs are vaginal bleeding, cramping pain in the lower abdomen and passing clots or tissue. Any bleeding in pregnancy should be checked by a doctor. The woman must never be blamed, and she should not blame herself.
body.hg: Miscarriage ka matlab hai shuruaati ya beech ke mahinon mein pregnancy ka apne aap khatam ho jaana, jo sabse zyada pehle baarah hafton mein hota hai. Yeh common hai. Iski usual wajah embryo ke chromosomes mein problem hoti hai, jo fertilisation ke time chance se ho jaati hai aur jisse koi rok nahi sakta tha. Normal life se yeh nahi hota: na kuch uthane se, na seedhiyan chadhne se, na travel, kaam, exercise, jhagde, stress, spicy khaane ya sex se. Iske signs hain vaginal bleeding, lower abdomen mein cramping dard aur clots ya tissue nikalna. Pregnancy mein kisi bhi bleeding ko doctor se check karana chahiye. Woman ko kabhi blame nahi karna chahiye, aur usse khud ko bhi blame nahi karna chahiye.

h.en: Ectopic pregnancy: the emergency

body.en: In an ectopic pregnancy the fertilised egg implants outside the uterus, usually in a fallopian tube. It cannot develop into a baby and cannot be moved to the uterus. As it grows, the tube can tear and cause dangerous internal bleeding. Symptoms usually appear between the fourth and twelfth week: pain low in the abdomen on one side, vaginal bleeding or brown watery discharge, pain at the tip of the shoulder, and dizziness or fainting. Anyone who could be pregnant and has these signs needs a hospital immediately; call 112 if they collapse. Doctors treat it with medicine or an operation, and with early treatment people recover well.
body.hg: Ectopic pregnancy mein fertilised egg uterus ke bahar implant ho jaata hai, usually fallopian tube mein. Yeh baby mein develop nahi ho sakta aur isse uterus mein shift bhi nahi kiya ja sakta. Jaise-jaise yeh badhta hai, tube phat sakti hai aur body ke andar dangerous bleeding ho sakti hai. Symptoms usually chauthe se baarahve hafte ke beech dikhte hain: lower abdomen mein ek taraf dard, vaginal bleeding ya brown watery discharge, shoulder ki tip mein dard, aur chakkar ya behoshi. Jo koi bhi pregnant ho sakti hai aur usme yeh signs hon, usse turant hospital le jaana chahiye; agar woh gir pade toh 112 par call karo. Doctors iska treatment medicine ya operation se karte hain, aur jaldi treatment milne par log achhi tarah recover ho jaate hain.

h.en: After a loss: body, feelings and support
h.hg: Loss ke baad: body, feelings aur support

body.en: After a miscarriage or ectopic pregnancy, bleeding usually settles within a couple of weeks and periods typically return within one to two months. Fever, foul-smelling discharge, heavy bleeding that soaks a pad every hour, or severe pain need urgent medical care. Feelings vary: grief, numbness, guilt, relief, or all of these, and partners grieve too. One loss does not usually mean future pregnancies will fail, and a doctor can advise when it is safe to try again. To support someone, say 'I am sorry, this was not your fault' and listen. Avoid 'it was for the best' or 'you can have another'. Tele-MANAS on 14416 offers free emotional support.
body.hg: Miscarriage ya ectopic pregnancy ke baad bleeding usually do-ek hafte mein settle ho jaati hai aur periods aksar ek se do mahine ke andar laut aate hain. Bukhaar, badbudaar discharge, itni heavy bleeding ki har ghante pad bheeg jaaye, ya tez dard ho, toh urgent medical care chahiye. Feelings alag-alag ho sakti hain: grief, numb ho jaana, guilt, relief, ya yeh sab ek saath, aur partner ko bhi dukh hota hai. Ek loss ka matlab usually yeh nahi hota ki aage ki pregnancies bhi fail hongi, aur doctor bata sakte hain ki dobara try karna kab safe hai. Kisi ko support karna ho, toh bolo 'mujhe bahut dukh hai, isme tumhari galti nahi thi' aur suno. 'Jo hua achhe ke liye hua' ya 'doosra ho jaayega' jaisi baaton se bacho. Tele-MANAS 14416 par free emotional support milta hai.

claim.en: Complete bed rest can prevent a miscarriage.
claim.hg: Complete bed rest se miscarriage roka ja sakta hai.

fact.en: Most early miscarriages are caused by chance chromosome problems in the embryo, and bed rest has not been shown to prevent them. Normal daily activity does not cause a miscarriage either. Bleeding in pregnancy needs a doctor's assessment, not self-treatment.
fact.hg: Zyadatar early miscarriages embryo ke chromosomes mein chance se hui problem se hote hain, aur yeh prove nahi hua hai ki bed rest unhe rokta hai. Normal daily activity bhi miscarriage ki wajah nahi banti. Pregnancy mein bleeding ho toh doctor ka assessment chahiye, self-treatment nahi.

takeaways.en: Early, regular prenatal check-ups find problems while they are still treatable.
takeaways.hg: Jaldi shuru kiye gaye regular prenatal check-ups problems ko tab pakad lete hain jab unka treatment possible hota hai.

takeaways.en: Most miscarriages come from chance chromosome problems, not from anything the woman did.
takeaways.hg: Zyadatar miscarriages chromosomes ki chance wali problem se hote hain, woman ke kisi kaam se nahi.

takeaways.en: One-sided abdominal pain, bleeding, shoulder-tip pain or fainting in early pregnancy means hospital now.
takeaways.hg: Early pregnancy mein ek taraf pet dard, bleeding, shoulder-tip pain ya behoshi ka matlab hai: abhi hospital.

activity.en: Write two sentences you could say to a friend or relative who has had a miscarriage, and two you would avoid. Keep them in mind; people remember who was kind.
activity.hg: Do aise sentences likho jo tum kisi aise friend ya relative ko bol sakte ho jiska miscarriage hua ho, aur do aise jinse tum bachoge. Inhe yaad rakho; logon ko yaad rehta hai ki mushkil waqt mein kaun kind tha.

q.en: Sana is seven weeks pregnant. She has sharp pain on the right side of her lower abdomen, some bleeding, and feels faint. What should happen?
q.hg: Sana saat hafte pregnant hai. Uske lower abdomen mein right side tez dard hai, thodi bleeding hai, aur usse chakkar aa rahe hain. Kya hona chahiye?

options.en: Rest at home and see whether it settles by tomorrow
options.hg: Ghar par rest kare aur dekhe ki kal tak theek hota hai ya nahi

options.en: Take a painkiller and drink water
options.hg: Painkiller le aur paani piye

options.en: Go to a hospital emergency department immediately
options.hg: Turant hospital emergency jaaye

options.en: Do another home pregnancy test
options.hg: Ek aur home pregnancy test kare

explain.en: These are warning signs of ectopic pregnancy, which can cause internal bleeding. It needs urgent hospital assessment, not waiting.
explain.hg: Yeh ectopic pregnancy ke warning signs hain, jisme internal bleeding ho sakti hai. Isme wait nahi, hospital mein urgent assessment chahiye.

q.en: Lifting a heavy bucket or having an argument is a common cause of miscarriage.
q.hg: Bhaari baalti uthana ya jhagda hona miscarriage ki common wajah hai.

options.en: True
options.hg: Sahi

options.en: False
options.hg: Galat

explain.en: Everyday activity and stress do not cause miscarriage. The usual cause is a chance chromosome problem in the embryo.
explain.hg: Roz ke kaam aur stress se miscarriage nahi hota. Usual wajah embryo ke chromosomes mein chance se hui problem hai.

warning.en: Heavy bleeding, severe abdominal pain, shoulder-tip pain, fainting or fever during or after a pregnancy is an emergency: go to a hospital or call 112.
warning.hg: Pregnancy ke dauraan ya uske baad heavy bleeding, pet mein tez dard, shoulder-tip pain, behoshi ya bukhaar emergency hai: hospital jao ya 112 par call karo.

title.en: Fertility: How It Works and What People Get Wrong
title.hg: Fertility: Kaise Kaam Karti Hai aur Log Kya Galat Samajhte Hain

subtitle.en: The fertile window, age, infertility and reproductive conditions
subtitle.hg: Fertile window, age, infertility aur reproductive conditions

hook.en: Half the country thinks pregnancy happens instantly; the other half blames the woman when it does not. Both are wrong.
hook.hg: Aadha desh sochta hai ki pregnancy turant ho jaati hai; baaki aadha, na hone par woman ko blame karta hai. Dono galat hain.

objectives.en: Explain the fertile window and why conception often takes months.
objectives.hg: Fertile window samjha sako aur bata sako ki conceive karne mein aksar mahine kyun lagte hain.

objectives.en: Define infertility and say when a couple should seek evaluation.
objectives.hg: Infertility define kar sako aur bata sako ki couple ko evaluation kab karani chahiye.

objectives.en: Name common reproductive conditions and the main kinds of treatment.
objectives.hg: Common reproductive conditions aur treatment ke main types ke naam bata sako.

h.en: The fertile window

body.en: Pregnancy is possible only on a few days of each cycle. Ovulation happens about 14 days before the next period, not necessarily on day 14, so its date shifts with cycle length. The egg survives up to about 24 hours and sperm up to about five days, which makes a fertile window of roughly six days ending on the day of ovulation. Signs of ovulation include clear, stretchy cervical mucus and a slight rise in resting body temperature afterwards. Even with well-timed intercourse, a healthy couple has only a modest chance of conceiving in any one cycle, so taking several months is normal. Because ovulation can shift, the same calendar is unreliable as contraception.
body.hg: Har cycle mein pregnancy sirf kuch dinon mein hi possible hai. Ovulation agle period se lagbhag 14 din pehle hota hai, zaroori nahi ki cycle ke day 14 par, isliye cycle length ke saath iski date shift hoti rehti hai. Egg lagbhag 24 ghante tak aur sperm lagbhag paanch din tak zinda rehte hain, jisse kareeb chhe din ki fertile window banti hai jo ovulation ke din khatam hoti hai. Ovulation ke signs mein clear, stretchy cervical mucus aur uske baad resting body temperature ka thoda badhna shaamil hai. Sahi timing par intercourse karne par bhi ek healthy couple ke liye kisi ek cycle mein conceive karne ka chance modest hi hota hai, isliye kai mahine lagna normal hai. Kyunki ovulation shift ho sakta hai, yahi calendar contraception ke taur par reliable nahi hai.

h.en: Age, health and lifestyle

body.en: Fertility changes with age in everyone. People with ovaries are born with all their eggs; the number and quality fall gradually and more quickly from the mid-thirties, and miscarriage becomes more likely. Sperm are produced throughout life, but their quality also declines slowly with age. Smoking, heavy drinking, being very underweight or overweight, and untreated sexually transmitted infections such as chlamydia and gonorrhoea, which can scar the tubes, all reduce fertility in any gender. Anabolic steroids and some medicines can lower sperm counts. None of this is a deadline or a moral failing; it is information for planning, and many people conceive in their late thirties.
body.hg: Age ke saath har kisi ki fertility badalti hai. Jin logon ki ovaries hoti hain, woh apne saare eggs ke saath paida hote hain; eggs ki sankhya aur quality dheere-dheere ghatti hai aur mid-thirties se zyada tezi se, aur miscarriage ka chance badh jaata hai. Sperm poori life bante rehte hain, par age ke saath unki quality bhi dheere-dheere ghatti hai. Smoking, heavy drinking, bahut kam ya bahut zyada weight, aur chlamydia aur gonorrhoea jaise untreated STIs, jo tubes mein scarring kar sakte hain, yeh sab kisi bhi gender mein fertility ghatate hain. Anabolic steroids aur kuch medicines sperm count kam kar sakti hain. Inme se kuch bhi na deadline hai, na moral failing; yeh planning ke liye information hai, aur bahut se log late thirties mein bhi conceive karte hain.

h.en: Infertility is a medical condition, not a verdict
h.hg: Infertility ek medical condition hai, koi verdict nahi

body.en: Infertility means no pregnancy after twelve months or more of regular unprotected intercourse. The World Health Organization estimates that around one in six people worldwide experience it in their lifetime. The cause may lie with the male partner, the female partner, both, or remain unexplained, so both should be evaluated together; a semen analysis is simple and non-invasive. Causes include problems with ovulation, blocked tubes, endometriosis, fibroids, low sperm count or movement, and hormonal conditions. See a doctor after a year of trying, or after six months if the woman is over 35 or periods are irregular. Taunting or abandoning a woman for childlessness has no medical basis and causes real harm.
body.hg: Infertility ka matlab hai baarah mahine ya usse zyada time tak regular unprotected intercourse ke baad bhi pregnancy na hona. World Health Organization ka estimate hai ki duniya mein lagbhag har chhe mein se ek person apni life mein kabhi na kabhi isse guzarta hai. Wajah male partner mein ho sakti hai, female partner mein, dono mein, ya unexplained reh sakti hai, isliye dono ka evaluation saath mein hona chahiye; semen analysis simple aur non-invasive hai. Wajahon mein ovulation ki problem, blocked tubes, endometriosis, fibroids, low sperm count ya movement, aur hormonal conditions shaamil hain. Ek saal try karne ke baad doctor se milo, ya chhe mahine baad hi agar woman ki age 35 se zyada hai ya periods irregular hain. Bachcha na hone par woman ko taane dene ya chhod dene ka koi medical basis nahi hai aur isse real harm hota hai.

h.en: Conditions and treatments

body.en: Polycystic ovary syndrome (PCOS) is a common hormonal condition that can cause irregular periods, acne, excess hair growth and irregular ovulation; it is manageable, and many people with PCOS conceive. Endometriosis, where tissue similar to the uterus lining grows outside it, causes painful periods and can affect fertility. Thyroid problems and fibroids matter too. Treatment depends on the cause: medicines that trigger ovulation, surgery, intrauterine insemination (IUI), or in vitro fertilisation (IVF), in which eggs are fertilised in a laboratory. These are offered by qualified specialists, can be costly and tiring, and do not always succeed. Unproven powders and 'guaranteed' cures deserve suspicion. Adoption and living child-free are also complete, valid lives.
body.hg: Polycystic ovary syndrome (PCOS) ek common hormonal condition hai jisme periods irregular ho sakte hain, acne, extra hair growth aur irregular ovulation ho sakta hai; isse manage kiya ja sakta hai, aur PCOS wale bahut se log conceive karte hain. Endometriosis mein uterus ki lining jaisa tissue uterus ke bahar grow karne lagta hai, jisse periods mein tez dard hota hai aur fertility par asar pad sakta hai. Thyroid problems aur fibroids bhi matter karte hain. Treatment wajah par depend karta hai: ovulation trigger karne wali medicines, surgery, intrauterine insemination (IUI), ya in vitro fertilisation (IVF), jisme eggs ko lab mein fertilise kiya jaata hai. Yeh treatments qualified specialists karte hain, mehenge aur thakane wale ho sakte hain, aur hamesha successful nahi hote. Bina proof wale powders aur 'guaranteed' ilaaj par shak karna hi theek hai. Adoption aur child-free rehna bhi complete aur valid lives hain.

claim.en: Using contraception for years makes you infertile.
claim.hg: Saalon tak contraception use karne se infertility ho jaati hai.

fact.en: Contraceptive pills, condoms, IUDs and implants do not cause infertility; fertility returns after stopping them, though after the contraceptive injection it can take some months.
fact.hg: Contraceptive pills, condoms, IUDs aur implants infertility ki wajah nahi bante; inhe band karne ke baad fertility laut aati hai, halanki contraceptive injection ke baad isme kuch mahine lag sakte hain.

takeaways.en: The fertile window is about six days per cycle, and conceiving commonly takes several months.
takeaways.hg: Fertile window har cycle mein lagbhag chhe din ki hoti hai, aur conceive karne mein kai mahine lagna common hai.

takeaways.en: Infertility can come from either partner or both, so both should be evaluated.
takeaways.hg: Infertility ki wajah kisi bhi partner mein ya dono mein ho sakti hai, isliye dono ka evaluation hona chahiye.

takeaways.en: Conditions like PCOS and endometriosis are treatable by qualified doctors, and 'guaranteed' cures are a red flag.
takeaways.hg: PCOS aur endometriosis jaisi conditions ka treatment qualified doctors kar sakte hain, aur 'guaranteed' ilaaj red flag hain.

activity.en: Think of one comment you have heard about a childless couple or a woman 'running out of time'. Write how you would answer it now using one fact from this lesson.
activity.hg: Koi ek aisa comment yaad karo jo tumne kisi childless couple ya 'time nikal raha hai' wali woman ke baare mein suna ho. Likho ki ab tum is lesson ke kisi ek fact se uska jawab kaise doge.

options.en: During the period
options.hg: Period ke dauraan

options.en: On day 14 of the cycle for every person
options.hg: Har kisi mein cycle ke exactly day 14 par

options.en: About 14 days before the next period
options.hg: Agle period se lagbhag 14 din pehle

options.en: Immediately after intercourse
options.hg: Intercourse ke turant baad

explain.en: The gap between ovulation and the next period is fairly constant, so in longer or shorter cycles ovulation falls on a different day.
explain.hg: Ovulation aur agle period ke beech ka gap lagbhag constant rehta hai, isliye lambi ya chhoti cycle mein ovulation alag din par padta hai.

q.en: If a couple cannot conceive, only the woman needs to be tested.
q.hg: Agar kisi couple ko pregnancy nahi ho rahi, toh sirf woman ka test zaroori hai.

options.en: True
options.hg: Sahi

options.en: False
options.hg: Galat

explain.en: Male factors contribute to a large share of cases, and a semen analysis is one of the simplest first tests.
explain.hg: Bahut se cases mein male factors bhi hote hain, aur semen analysis sabse simple first tests mein se ek hai.

title.en: Your Pregnancy, Your Decision: Options, Law and After Birth
title.hg: Tumhari Pregnancy, Tumhara Decision: Options, Law aur Delivery Ke Baad

subtitle.en: Parenting, adoption, abortion under the MTP Act and postpartum basics
subtitle.hg: Parenting, adoption, MTP Act ke under abortion aur postpartum basics

hook.en: Parenting, adoption and abortion are all lawful options in India. The decision belongs to the pregnant person, not to the loudest relative.
hook.hg: India mein parenting, adoption aur abortion, teeno lawful options hain. Decision pregnant person ka hai, sabse loud relative ka nahi.

objectives.en: Describe the three lawful pregnancy options without judgement.
objectives.hg: Bina judgement ke pregnancy ke teeno lawful options bata sako.

objectives.en: State the main conditions of India's MTP Act and how they differ for minors.
objectives.hg: India ke MTP Act ki main conditions aur minors ke liye unka fark bata sako.

objectives.en: Recognise postpartum warning signs that need medical help.
objectives.hg: Postpartum ke woh warning signs pehchaan sako jinme medical help chahiye.

h.en: Reproductive autonomy and the three options

body.en: Reproductive autonomy means deciding for yourself whether, when and with whom to have children, free from force or pressure. Faced with a pregnancy, an adult has three lawful options: continue and parent, continue and place the child for adoption, or end the pregnancy. Useful questions for parenting include your health, money, housing, work or study plans, the support you can count on, and whether the relationship is safe. Partners and families can be consulted, but they cannot lawfully force a woman to continue or end a pregnancy. Under the MTP Act, an adult woman's own consent is what the law requires; her husband's or parents' permission is not.
body.hg: Reproductive autonomy ka matlab hai bina zor-zabardasti ya pressure ke khud decide karna ki bachche hon ya nahi, kab hon aur kiske saath hon. Pregnancy hone par ek adult ke paas teen lawful options hote hain: pregnancy continue karna aur parenting, pregnancy continue karna aur bachche ko adoption ke liye dena, ya pregnancy end karna. Parenting ke baare mein sochte waqt useful sawaal hain: tumhari health, paisa, rehne ki jagah, kaam ya padhai ke plans, kis support par bharosa kar sakte ho, aur relationship safe hai ya nahi. Partner aur family se salah li ja sakti hai, lekin woh legally kisi woman ko pregnancy continue ya end karne ke liye force nahi kar sakte. MTP Act ke under adult woman ki apni consent hi legal requirement hai; pati ya parents ki permission nahi.

h.en: Abortion as legal healthcare

body.en: The Medical Termination of Pregnancy Act, amended in 2021, allows abortion up to 20 weeks on one registered doctor's opinion, and from 20 to 24 weeks for specified categories, including sexual assault survivors and minors, on two doctors' opinions. Beyond 24 weeks it allows abortion for substantial foetal abnormalities through a Medical Board, or at any stage when a doctor finds it immediately necessary to save the woman's life; courts have permitted some other late cases. It covers married and unmarried women. Under 18, a guardian's written consent is needed and POCSO reporting duties apply. With a qualified doctor at an approved facility, abortion by medicines or a minor procedure is safe; untrained providers or unsupervised pills can kill.
body.hg: Medical Termination of Pregnancy Act, jisme 2021 mein amendment hua, ek registered doctor ki opinion par 20 hafte tak abortion allow karta hai, aur 20 se 24 hafte ke beech kuch specified categories ke liye, jinme sexual assault survivors aur minors shaamil hain, do doctors ki opinion par. 24 hafte ke baad yeh substantial foetal abnormalities hone par Medical Board ke through allow karta hai, ya kisi bhi stage par jab doctor ko lage ki woman ki jaan bachane ke liye yeh turant zaroori hai; courts ne kuch aur late cases mein bhi permission di hai. Yeh married aur unmarried, dono women par apply hota hai. 18 se kam umar mein guardian ki written consent zaroori hai, aur POCSO ki reporting duties apply hoti hain. Qualified doctor ke saath approved facility par medicines ya minor procedure se abortion safe hai; untrained log ya bina supervision ki pills jaan le sakti hain.

h.en: Adoption and parenting support

body.en: Adoption permanently transfers parental rights and duties to another family. The main route in India runs through the Central Adoption Resource Authority (CARA) and recognised agencies: a parent who cannot raise a child can surrender the child before the district Child Welfare Committee, with counselling and time to reconsider. Hindu personal law also allows direct adoption, often within the family, by formal ceremony and registered deed. Selling or buying a baby is a crime; handing one over with no legal process is illegal and unsafe. If you choose to parent, government programmes offer free antenatal care, hospital delivery and immunisation, with ASHA and anganwadi workers as the local link. No option makes someone a bad person.
body.hg: Adoption se parental rights aur duties hamesha ke liye doosri family ko transfer ho jaate hain. India mein iska main route Central Adoption Resource Authority (CARA) aur recognised agencies ke through jaata hai: jo parent bachche ko paal nahi sakta, woh district ki Child Welfare Committee ke saamne bachche ko surrender kar sakta hai, jisme counselling aur dobara sochne ka time milta hai. Hindu personal law bhi direct adoption allow karta hai, aksar family ke andar, formal ceremony aur registered deed ke saath. Baby ko bechna ya khareedna crime hai; bina legal process ke baby kisi ko de dena illegal aur unsafe hai. Agar tum parenting choose karte ho, toh government programmes mein antenatal care, hospital delivery aur immunisation free milta hai, aur ASHA aur anganwadi workers local link hain. Koi bhi option kisi ko bura insaan nahi banata.

h.en: After birth: postpartum basics

body.en: The six weeks after delivery are for recovery. Bleeding called lochia lightens over weeks; breasts fill with milk; stitches or a caesarean wound need time to heal. Go to hospital urgently for heavy bleeding, fever, foul-smelling discharge, severe headache or blurred vision, chest pain, breathlessness or a painful swollen calf. Tearfulness in the first two weeks, called baby blues, is common and passes. Low mood, anxiety or feeling unable to cope that lasts longer needs a doctor. Thoughts of harming yourself or the baby need help now: tell someone nearby and call Tele-MANAS 14416 or 112. Ovulation can return before the first period, so discuss contraception at the postnatal check-up.
body.hg: Delivery ke baad ke pehle chhe hafte recovery ka time hote hain. Bleeding, jisse lochia kehte hain, kuch hafton mein halki hoti jaati hai; breasts mein milk bharta hai; stitches ya caesarean ke wound ko bharne mein time lagta hai. Heavy bleeding, bukhaar, badbudaar discharge, tez sirdard ya dhundhla dikhna, chest pain, saans phoolna ya calf mein dard ke saath swelling ho, toh turant hospital jao. Pehle do hafton mein baat-baat par rona aana, jisse 'baby blues' kehte hain, common hai aur chala jaata hai. Agar low mood, anxiety ya 'mujhse nahi sambhal raha' wali feeling isse zyada chale, toh doctor ki help chahiye. Khud ko ya baby ko harm karne ke thoughts aayein toh abhi help lo: paas ke kisi insaan ko batao aur Tele-MANAS 14416 ya 112 par call karo. Ovulation pehle period se pehle hi laut sakta hai, isliye postnatal check-up mein contraception par baat karo.

claim.en: A married woman needs her husband's permission for an abortion.
claim.hg: Married woman ko abortion ke liye pati ki permission chahiye.

fact.en: Under the MTP Act, the consent required is that of the pregnant woman herself if she is an adult. A husband's or family's permission is not a legal requirement. If a facility insists on it, you can ask why or seek care at another approved facility.
fact.hg: MTP Act ke under, agar pregnant woman adult hai toh sirf uski apni consent zaroori hai. Pati ya family ki permission legal requirement nahi hai. Agar koi facility is par ade, toh tum wajah poochh sakti ho ya kisi doosri approved facility par ja sakti ho.

takeaways.en: Parenting, adoption and abortion are all lawful, and the decision rests with the pregnant person.
takeaways.hg: Parenting, adoption aur abortion, teeno lawful hain, aur decision pregnant person ka hai.

takeaways.en: Abortion under the MTP Act is safe with a qualified doctor at an approved facility, and earlier is simpler.
takeaways.hg: MTP Act ke under abortion qualified doctor aur approved facility par safe hai, aur jitna jaldi ho utna simple hai.

takeaways.en: After birth, heavy bleeding, fever, chest pain or thoughts of self-harm need immediate help.
takeaways.hg: Birth ke baad heavy bleeding, bukhaar, chest pain ya self-harm ke thoughts hon toh turant help chahiye.

activity.en: Privately write what you would want from the people around you if you ever faced an unplanned pregnancy: information, time, company at the clinic, silence. It clarifies what support you could offer someone else.
activity.hg: Privately likho ki agar tumhe kabhi unplanned pregnancy face karni pade, toh tum apne aaspaas ke logon se kya chahoge: information, time, clinic mein saath, ya silence. Isse clear hota hai ki tum kisi aur ko kaisa support de sakte ho.

q.en: Under the MTP Act, whose consent is legally required for an adult woman's abortion?
q.hg: MTP Act ke under, adult woman ke abortion ke liye legally kiski consent zaroori hai?

options.en: Her husband's
options.hg: Uske pati ki

options.en: Her parents'
options.hg: Uske parents ki

options.en: Her own
options.hg: Uski apni

options.en: Her husband's and in-laws' together
options.hg: Pati aur sasural walon ki milkar

explain.en: For an adult, the law asks for her own consent, not her husband's or family's. A guardian's written consent is needed if she is under 18, or in the Act's narrow case of an adult with a mental illness.
explain.hg: Adult ke case mein law woman ki apni consent maangta hai, pati ya family ki nahi. Guardian ki written consent tab chahiye jab woh 18 se kam umar ki ho, ya Act mein tay us limited case mein jab adult woman mental illness se grast ho.

q.en: After childbirth, ovulation can return before the first period comes back.
q.hg: Delivery ke baad ovulation pehla period aane se pehle hi laut sakta hai.

options.en: True
options.hg: Sahi

options.en: False
options.hg: Galat

explain.en: An egg is released before the first postpartum period, so pregnancy is possible without any warning bleed.
explain.hg: Delivery ke baad ke pehle period se pehle hi egg release ho jaata hai, isliye bina kisi warning bleed ke bhi pregnancy possible hai.

warning.en: Laws can change and this is general information, not legal advice. Never use abortion pills without a qualified doctor; heavy bleeding, fever or severe pain after any pregnancy event needs urgent hospital care. Thoughts of harming yourself or your baby need help now: call Tele-MANAS 14416 or 112.
warning.hg: Laws badal sakte hain aur yeh general information hai, legal advice nahi. Abortion pills qualified doctor ke bina kabhi mat lo; pregnancy se judi kisi bhi event ke baad heavy bleeding, bukhaar ya tez dard ho toh turant hospital jao. Khud ko ya baby ko harm karne ke thoughts aayein toh abhi help lo: Tele-MANAS 14416 ya 112 par call karo.

title.en: Son Preference, Unsafe Abortion and the Blame Game
title.hg: Bete ki Chaah, Unsafe Abortion aur Blame Game

subtitle.en: Sex selection and the law, who is really 'responsible' for a daughter or for infertility, and where safe abortion care is
subtitle.hg: Sex selection aur law, beti hone ya baccha na hone ka 'zimmedaar' asal mein kaun hai, aur safe abortion care kahan milti hai

hook.en: A woman's body gets blamed for the baby's sex, for the missing baby and for the abortion she was pushed into. Biology and the law tell a very different story.
hook.hg: Aurat ki body pe bacche ke sex ka, baccha na hone ka, aur us abortion ka bhi blame lagta hai jisme use dhakela gaya. Biology aur law kuch aur hi kahani batate hain.

objectives.en: Explain what son preference and sex selection do to girls, women and whole communities.
objectives.hg: Samjha sako ki bete ki chaah aur sex selection ladkiyon, women aur poori community ke saath kya karte hain.

objectives.en: State in plain language what the PC-PNDT Act bans, and that abortion itself remains legal healthcare.
objectives.hg: Simple language mein bata sako ki PC-PNDT Act kis cheez ko ban karta hai, aur yeh ki abortion khud legal healthcare hi hai.

objectives.en: Recognise the dangers of unsafe abortion and name where safe, legal care is available.
objectives.hg: Unsafe abortion ke dangers pehchaan sako aur bata sako ki safe, legal care kahan milti hai.

h.en: Son preference and the missing girls
h.hg: Bete ki chaah aur gayab hoti betiyan

body.en: Many families treat a son as security, lineage and pride and a daughter as a cost, partly because of dowry and the belief that she 'belongs' to another home. This is son preference. Its harshest form is finding out the sex of a foetus and ending the pregnancy because it is a girl. Daughters who are born may still get less food, schooling and medical care. The result shows in India's population counts: noticeably fewer girls than boys, a wider gap than nature produces. Scarcity has not made women more valued. Areas with far fewer women have seen brides bought or trafficked, early and forced marriages, and more violence.
body.hg: Bahut si families mein bete ko budhape ka sahara, vansh aur shaan maana jata hai, jabki beti ko kharcha samjha jata hai, kuch had tak dahej ki wajah se aur is soch ki wajah se ki woh 'paraye ghar ki' hai. Isi ko son preference kehte hain. Iska sabse harsh roop hai foetus ka sex pata karna aur ladki hone pe pregnancy khatam karwa dena. Jo betiyan paida ho jaati hain, unhe bhi aksar kam khana, kam padhai aur kam medical care milti hai. Result India ki population counts mein dikhta hai: ladkon ke comparison mein ladkiyan clearly kam hain, aur yeh gap natural gap se kaafi zyada hai. Ladkiyan kam hone se unki value badhi nahi hai. Jin areas mein women bahut kam hain, wahan dulhanein kharidi gayi hain ya trafficking (taskari) karke laayi gayi hain, kam umar ki aur zabardasti ki shaadiyan hui hain, aur violence badhi hai.

h.en: What the law bans, and what it does not
h.hg: Law kya ban karta hai, aur kya nahi

body.en: The PC-PNDT Act, 1994 makes it illegal to use ultrasound or any other test to find out or reveal the sex of a foetus, to select sex before conception, or to advertise such services. Clinics must be registered, and doctors, clinic owners and relatives who demand the test can all be punished. The law presumes that the pregnant woman was pressured unless shown otherwise. Ultrasound for the baby's health is legal and important. Abortion is not banned either: it remains legal healthcare under the MTP Act, within that Act's conditions. What is banned is choosing by sex. This is a plain-language summary; laws change, so check with a lawyer.
body.hg: PC-PNDT Act, 1994 ke under ultrasound ya kisi bhi doosre test se foetus ka sex pata karna ya batana, conception se pehle sex select karna, ya aisi services ka advertisement karna illegal hai. Clinics ka registered hona zaroori hai, aur doctors, clinic owners aur test ki demand karne wale relatives, sabko saza ho sakti hai. Law yeh maankar chalta hai ki pregnant woman pe pressure daala gaya tha, jab tak ulta prove na ho. Bacche ki health ke liye ultrasound legal hai aur important bhi. Abortion bhi banned nahi hai: MTP Act ki conditions ke andar woh legal healthcare hi hai. Ban sex ke basis pe choose karne pe hai. Yeh plain-language summary hai; laws badalte rehte hain, isliye lawyer se check kar lo.

h.en: Biology versus blame

body.en: Every egg carries an X chromosome. A sperm carries either X or Y, and which one fertilises the egg is pure chance. So if anyone's cell 'decides' a daughter, it is the father's, and he cannot control it either. No diet, ritual, timing or medicine changes this. Infertility gets pinned on women in the same way. Male factors such as a low sperm count or poor sperm movement are involved roughly as often as female factors, and a semen test is simple and painless. Yet many wives are taunted, threatened with a second marriage or taken to healers while the husband is never tested. Blame is not a diagnosis.
body.hg: Har egg mein X chromosome hota hai. Sperm mein X ya Y mein se koi ek hota hai, aur kaun sa sperm egg se milega, yeh pure chance hai. Matlab agar kisi ka cell beti hona 'decide' karta hai, toh woh father ka hai, aur uske control mein bhi yeh nahi hai. Koi diet, pooja-paath, timing ya dawa isse nahi badalti. Baccha na hone ka blame bhi isi tarah aurat pe daal diya jata hai. Sach yeh hai ki low sperm count ya sperm ki kamzor movement jaise male factors lagbhag utni hi baar involved hote hain jitni baar female factors, aur semen test simple hai aur painless hai. Phir bhi bahut si wives ko taane sunne padte hain, doosri shaadi ki dhamki milti hai ya unhe ek ke baad ek baba-hakeem ke paas le jaya jata hai, jabki husband ka test kabhi hota hi nahi. Blame koi diagnosis nahi hai.

h.en: Unsafe abortion, safe care and the pressure to have children
h.hg: Unsafe abortion, safe care aur baccha paida karne ka pressure

body.en: Abortion becomes dangerous when an untrained person does it or pills are taken without a doctor's assessment. Nobody has checked how advanced the pregnancy is or whether it is ectopic, or is watching for heavy bleeding, infection or an incomplete abortion. Women die or become infertile this way, usually because shame kept them from hospitals. Qualified doctors provide safe, legal abortion at government hospitals and approved private facilities. Pressure runs both ways: some are forced to end a pregnancy, others to keep having children until a son arrives. Whether and when to have a child is a decision, not a duty. If you are being forced, call 181 or 112.
body.hg: Abortion tab dangerous ban jata hai jab koi untrained insaan use kare, ya jab doctor ke assessment ke bina pills le li jaayein. Tab kisi ne check nahi kiya hota ki pregnancy kitne hafte ki hai ya kahin woh ectopic toh nahi, aur heavy bleeding, infection ya incomplete abortion pe nazar rakhne wala bhi koi nahi hota. Isi tarah women ki jaan jaati hai ya unki fertility chali jaati hai, aur aksar wajah yeh hoti hai ki sharam aur secrecy ne unhe hospital se door rakha. Safe, legal abortion qualified doctors government hospitals aur approved private facilities mein karte hain. Pressure dono taraf se aata hai: kuch women ko pregnancy khatam karne pe majboor kiya jata hai, toh kuch ko tab tak bacche paida karte rehne pe jab tak beta na ho jaye. Baccha karna hai ya nahi, aur kab, yeh ek decision hai, duty nahi. Agar tum pe zabardasti ho rahi hai, toh 181 ya 112 pe call karo.

claim.en: If girls become fewer, society will automatically start valuing them more.
claim.hg: Agar ladkiyan kam ho jayengi, toh society apne aap unki zyada value karne lagegi.

fact.en: It has worked the other way. Areas with far fewer women have seen brides bought or trafficked from poorer regions, pressure for early and forced marriage, and tighter control over women's movement, not more respect. Respect comes from treating daughters as equals, not from making them scarce.
fact.hg: Hua iska ulta hai. Jin areas mein women bahut kam hain, wahan gareeb regions se dulhanein kharidkar ya trafficking (taskari) karke laayi gayi hain, kam umar mein aur zabardasti shaadi ka pressure badha hai, aur women ke aane-jaane pe control aur tight hua hai, respect nahi badhi. Respect betiyon ko equal maanne se aati hai, unhe kam kar dene se nahi.

takeaways.en: Finding out or revealing a foetus's sex is a crime in India; a lawful abortion with a qualified doctor is not.
takeaways.hg: India mein foetus ka sex pata karna ya batana crime hai; qualified doctor se law ke andar karaya gaya abortion crime nahi hai.

takeaways.en: A sperm, by chance, sets a baby's sex, and infertility involves men roughly as often as women, so blaming the woman is biologically wrong.
takeaways.hg: Bacche ka sex chance se sperm set karta hai, aur infertility mein men lagbhag utni hi baar involved hote hain jitni baar women, isliye aurat ko blame karna biologically galat hai.

takeaways.en: Abortion by untrained people or with unsupervised pills can kill; safe care exists at government hospitals and approved facilities.
takeaways.hg: Untrained logon se ya bina supervision ki pills se kiya gaya abortion jaan le sakta hai; safe care government hospitals aur approved facilities mein milti hai.

activity.en: Listen for the script. Over the next week, privately note three things you hear at home, in serials or in the neighbourhood about sons, daughters or 'good news', such as a blessing that wishes for a son. Next to each, write the fact from this lesson that answers it.
activity.hg: Script pe dhyaan do. Agle ek hafte mein, privately aisi teen baatein note karo jo tum ghar mein, serials mein ya mohalle mein beton, betiyon ya 'good news' ke baare mein sunte ho, jaise beta hone ka aashirwad. Har baat ke aage is lesson ka woh fact likho jo uska jawab deta hai.

q.en: Under the PC-PNDT Act, which of these is illegal in India?
q.hg: PC-PNDT Act ke under inme se kya India mein illegal hai?

options.en: An ultrasound to check the baby's growth and health
options.hg: Bacche ki growth aur health check karne ke liye ultrasound

options.en: Telling the parents the sex of the foetus
options.hg: Parents ko foetus ka sex batana

options.en: An abortion by a registered doctor within the legal conditions
options.hg: Registered doctor ka legal conditions ke andar kiya gaya abortion

options.en: A semen test for the husband
options.hg: Husband ka semen test

explain.en: The Act bans finding out or revealing the sex of a foetus and sex selection. Health ultrasounds, lawful abortion and fertility tests all remain legal.
explain.hg: Yeh Act foetus ka sex pata karne ya batane aur sex selection ko ban karta hai. Health ultrasound, lawful abortion aur fertility tests, sab legal hain.

q.en: Two days after taking abortion pills given by an unqualified local 'doctor', Rekha's cousin has heavy bleeding and fever. The family wants to wait so that nobody finds out. What is the safest step?
q.hg: Ek unqualified local 'doctor' ki di hui abortion pills lene ke do din baad Rekha ki cousin ko heavy bleeding aur bukhaar hai. Family wait karna chahti hai taaki kisi ko pata na chale. Sabse safe step kya hai?

options.en: Rest at home for another day and see if it settles
options.hg: Ek din aur ghar pe rest karke dekhna ki theek hota hai ya nahi

options.en: Go back to the same person and ask for stronger medicine
options.hg: Usi insaan ke paas wapas jaakar zyada strong dawa maangna

options.en: Go to a hospital immediately and tell the doctor what was taken
options.hg: Turant hospital jaana aur doctor ko batana ki kya liya gaya tha

explain.en: Heavy bleeding with fever after an abortion can mean infection or an incomplete abortion, which can be fatal. Hospital care is urgent, and the doctor needs the facts to treat her.
explain.hg: Abortion ke baad bukhaar ke saath heavy bleeding ka matlab infection ya incomplete abortion ho sakta hai, jo fatal ho sakta hai. Hospital care urgent hai, aur treat karne ke liye doctor ko poori sachchai pata honi chahiye.

warning.en: After any abortion or miscarriage, heavy bleeding, fever, severe abdominal pain, foul-smelling discharge or fainting need hospital care immediately; call 112. If you are under 18, an abortion needs a guardian's written consent and doctors must report under POCSO, so they cannot promise complete secrecy; 1098 can guide you. Laws change; this is not legal advice.
warning.hg: Kisi bhi abortion ya miscarriage ke baad heavy bleeding, bukhaar, pet mein tez dard, badbudaar discharge ya behoshi ho toh turant hospital jao; 112 pe call karo. Agar tum 18 se kam ho, toh abortion ke liye guardian ki written consent zaroori hai aur doctors ko POCSO ke under report karna hota hai, isliye woh complete secrecy ka promise nahi kar sakte; 1098 tumhe guide kar sakta hai. Laws badalte rehte hain; yeh legal advice nahi hai.

laws.en: Pre-Conception and Pre-Natal Diagnostic Techniques (PC-PNDT) Act, 1994
